title: Where a release goes
description: Every tool (zazzle, the launcher, and the tools it runs: the daemon with zazz-script-runner, csharp-indexer, fix-network, free-disk-space, git-tools, ai-agent-rules) is released together, one version for all, with cyberspace-generator, which is built in the cyberspace-explorer repository and shipped at the release pinned in release/cyberspace-generator.version, by release.sh in the continuous_integration_and_delivery repository, which the owner runs by hand (pipeline.json). It runs on each developer's own machine; these are the places a version is installed from. Only zazzle (and z) goes on PATH; the tools sit in libexec/zazzle. ai-agent is not in the tarballs or the formula: it is a JIT tool that the daemon downloads from icelander.net on first use.

entities.title: GitHub release
entities.summary: One release per vX.Y.Z tag, with no release notes, holding zazzle-macos-universal.tar.gz (bin/zazzle with bin/z as a relative link to it; libexec/zazzle with nine universal binaries, among them zazz-script-runner and the three git-tools programs; libexec/indexer with the C# indexer gzipped for arm64 and x64), the Linux tarballs for x86_64 and aarch64 in the same layout (zazzle and z; daemon, zazz-script-runner, csharp-indexer and cyberspace-generator), their checksums and the Homebrew bottle.
entities.purpose: The canonical copy of each version; the formula's bottle and its source fallback download from it.
entities.deployedBy: release.sh, through gh with the owner's login, once every tarball has built: it creates the release on the commit with the macOS tarball, then uploads the Linux tarballs and the bottle
entities.rollback: No rollback is automated or documented. Each tag keeps its own release, so an earlier version stays downloadable.

relationships.description: A library this release delivers inside the daemon.

entities.title: icelander.net/downloads
entities.summary: The same tarballs and checksums, copied to the download bucket under zazzle/<tag>/ and zazzle/latest/, served at https://icelander.net/downloads/zazzle/.
entities.environment: The icelander-downloads bucket on Cloudflare R2
entities.purpose: A stable latest/ link for the README's curl install, and one folder per version.
entities.deployedBy: release.sh, with the owner's CLOUDFLARE_R2_TOKEN, through r2-put.sh, which retries each upload up to five times
entities.promotedFrom: The same release.sh run's build; there is no staging.
entities.rollback: No rollback is automated or documented. latest/ is overwritten by each release; zazzle/<tag>/ keeps every version.

entities.title: Homebrew tap zazzcat/homebrew-z
entities.summary: One formula, zazzle, in the external tap zazzcat/homebrew-z, pointing at the release's tarball and bottle; it installs every macOS binary and expands the C# indexer for the Mac's CPU after install. Users run brew install zazzcat/z/zazzle, which adds the tap on first use.
entities.environment: Formula/zazzle.rb on the default branch of zazzcat/homebrew-z, read by brew
entities.purpose: Installs and upgrades without a Gatekeeper prompt, since Homebrew does not quarantine what a formula installs.
entities.deployedBy: release.sh, last, pushing to the tap with the owner's git credentials or HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN
entities.rollback: No rollback is automated or documented. Each release moves the formula to the new tag; the tap's git history keeps the earlier formulas.

entities.title: Language modules on icelander.net
entities.summary: Each release's language modules (one .dylib per language, universal, on macOS; one .so per language and Linux architecture) and their manifest, under icelander.net/downloads/zazzle/vX.Y.Z/languages/{macos-universal,linux-x86_64,linux-aarch64}/. Only the tag's directory gets them, not latest, because a daemon accepts only its own release's modules.
entities.environment: Cloudflare R2 bucket icelander-downloads, served as icelander.net/downloads
entities.purpose: The daemon downloads a module from here the first time a file needs it, or on `zazzle languages fetch`.
entities.deployedBy: release.sh, after the macOS and Linux builds, through r2-put.sh
entities.rollback: No rollback; each tag keeps its own directory, which its daemon keeps using.

entities.title: JIT tools on icelander.net
entities.summary: Each release's JIT tools (ai-agent: universal on macOS, signed when configured, with Metal for Apple Silicon; one per Linux architecture) and their manifest, under icelander.net/downloads/zazzle/vX.Y.Z/tools/{macos-universal,linux-x86_64,linux-aarch64}/. Only the tag's directory gets them, not latest, because a daemon accepts only the tools whose SHA-256s were compiled into it (ZAZZLE_TOOLS_MANIFEST). They are not in the tarballs, the bottle or the formula.
entities.environment: Cloudflare R2 bucket icelander-downloads, served as icelander.net/downloads
entities.purpose: `zazzle daemon llm` downloads ai-agent from here the first time `zazzle agent llm` or `zazzle agent prompt` runs. The models ai-agent runs come from huggingface.co, not from a release.
entities.deployedBy: release.sh: tools.sh builds them in the alpha and macOS builds on the Mac and in each Linux build in the container; release.sh uploads them through r2-put.sh
entities.rollback: No rollback; each tag keeps its own directory, which its daemon keeps using.
